visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Wrong Exception Type Is Caught
visualizerParams.problemDescription: parse("4x2") should print Not a number: 4x2 and return -1, but the program crashes with a NumberFormatException.

solution.explanation: A catch block only handles the exception type it names (and its subclasses). parseInt throws NumberFormatException, which is not an ArithmeticException, so it escapes uncaught. Note that finally still ran before the crash.
